features.name: resource_frequency_log
features.description: Log-frequency of RESOURCE based on training count proxy via the row value itself; uses log1p of the numeric resource id as a smooth severity proxy when frequency table unavailable.
features.expected_model_benefit: Smooth continuous projection of resource identity for linear margin separation.

features.name: mgr_id_log
features.description: Log-transformed manager id providing a smooth continuous representation for linear models.
features.expected_model_benefit: Provides continuous numeric projection of manager identity.

features.name: role_title_code_match
features.description: Binary indicator whether ROLE_TITLE equals ROLE_CODE (they are typically aligned); deviation indicates anomaly.
features.expected_model_benefit: Direct linear signal for role consistency anomalies.

features.name: role_title_code_diff_abs
features.description: Absolute numeric difference between ROLE_TITLE and ROLE_CODE as a smooth divergence measure.
features.expected_model_benefit: Continuous magnitude of role inconsistency for SVM margin.

features.name: rollup_hierarchy_match
features.description: Indicator that ROLE_ROLLUP_1 equals ROLE_ROLLUP_2 indicating flat hierarchy.

features.name: rollup_log_ratio
features.description: Log-ratio between ROLE_ROLLUP_1 and ROLE_ROLLUP_2 as smooth hierarchical structure feature.
features.expected_model_benefit: Smooth ratio useful for linear projection.

features.name: deptname_log
features.description: Log-transformed department name id for smooth continuous encoding.

features.name: family_desc_vs_family_diff
features.description: Log-abs difference between ROLE_FAMILY_DESC and ROLE_FAMILY indicating role-family alignment.
features.expected_model_benefit: Smooth divergence signal between related role attributes.

features.name: resource_to_mgr_log_ratio
features.description: Log-ratio between RESOURCE and MGR_ID, providing a smooth interaction projection.
features.expected_model_benefit: Captures relative magnitude relationship for linear SVM.

features.name: common_rollup1_indicator
features.description: Indicator that ROLE_ROLLUP_1 equals the dominant value 117961 (covers ~65% of rows).
features.expected_model_benefit: Captures membership in dominant organizational rollup.

features.name: role_attribute_dispersion
features.description: Standard-deviation-like dispersion of log-encoded role attributes capturing intra-row variability.
features.expected_model_benefit: Weighted composite useful for linear margin.

features.name: access_request_specificity
features.description: Semantic judgment of how specific or unusual the access request appears, blending resource rarity and role hierarchy depth. Higher values indicate more atypical access patterns warranting scrutiny. Computed from row-value characteristics only.
features.expected_model_benefit: Provides a normalized soft severity score complementing deterministic features for linear SVM margin.
